title: 第1570章 霸道北君凛冬门外第1569章 意外的关系圣城使团
slug: 自缚禁地五百年我当散修你哭啥
content_zh:
北君二字出口，原本还热闹融洽的宴席上，立刻安静了一瞬。
哪怕是身为城主的风天扬，也都僵了僵。
但并不是那种和北君站在一条线，不知道该如何糊弄顾修的样子，反倒是有一种，畏惧着什么的感觉。
使团众人心中奇怪，路知意更是毫不避讳地问道：“你们是在害怕那个北君吗？”
这个……
风啸城众人互相对视一眼，其中一人压低声音道：“北君那人很霸道，而且最不喜欢他人私下妄议，以前有不少人因为私底下讨论他被弄死的。”
“就因为私底下聊了几句，就要杀人？”
路知意有些不可思议。
那人苦笑道：“那毕竟是圣人，不容许任何人置喙的，当然了，其实只要遵守北君的规矩，一般倒也没事。”
其他人也连连点头，你一句我一句说了起来。
内容整合起来差不多就一个意思。
北君这人，极为霸道，而且极重视规矩。
他统御几城之时，定下过不少规矩，用的是顺我者昌逆我者亡的法子，有人反抗便即刻杀无赦。
但同样的。
若是遵循他定下的规矩行事，北君除了态度有时候会比较高高在上之外，倒也没有做什么天怒人怨的事情。
“北君的实力如何？”
楚湘灵更好奇这个。
“很强。”
风天扬回道：
“北君是真真正正的神道圣人，修为深不可测，特别是在北边城池，等同于无敌。”

“其实若不是他的实力需要借助环境，当初和南君的争执早就结束了，南君若去凛冬城，必不是北君的对手。”
“除此之外，北君的寒霜军战力也极其强大，他们每一个都是用特殊方法修炼出来的，不惧生死，绝对忠诚，所过之处没有任何一座城池能够抵挡。”
“……”
伴随着对北君越来越多的了解，使团众人心里也不由开始紧张了起来。
怎么看。
接下来的凛冬城之行，似乎都不会太舒坦。
当天晚上，众人干脆也没忙着继续启程，而是就地在风啸城休整了一晚，次日一早的时候才整装出发。
风天扬派出了一队禁军护送。
离开之前，风天扬私底下找上了顾修：“陛下，风天扬此人实力强悍，性子霸道，若是没有把握，最好还是不要和他发生冲突为好。”
“多谢风城主告知。”
顾修自是点头表示感激，随即才率领这增加到五百多人的队伍，开始出发。
接下来的一路，倒也算顺利。
偶尔会遇到一些孽妖干扰，但没有高阶孽妖坐镇，寻常孽妖在这这支精锐之师面前脆弱的不堪一击，并未引起半点波澜。
content_en:
When the word "Bei Jun" came out, the originally lively and harmonious banquet immediately fell silent for a moment.
Even Feng Tianyang, the city lord, froze.
But it wasn't like he was on the same side as Beijun and didn't know how to fool Gu Xiu. Instead, he felt like he was afraid of something.
Everyone in the mission felt strange, and Lu Zhiyi asked without hesitation: "Are you afraid of that Lord Bei?"
This...
Everyone in Fengxiao City looked at each other, and one of them lowered his voice and said, "Bei Jun is very domineering, and he doesn't like others to discuss things in private. Many people have been killed because of discussing him in private."
"Just because we had a few private conversations, you want to kill someone?"
Lu Zhiyi was a little surprised.
The man smiled bitterly and said: "He is a saint after all, and no one is allowed to comment. Of course, as long as you abide by Beijun's rules, it will usually be fine."
The others also nodded, and you started talking to me one by one.
When the content is integrated, it almost means the same thing.
Beijun is a very domineering person and attaches great importance to rules.
When he ruled several cities, he set many rules, using the method of making those who obeyed me prosper and those who rebelled against me perished. Anyone who resisted would be immediately killed without mercy.
But the same thing.
If he followed the rules he set, Beijun would not do anything that would make anyone angry, except that his attitude would sometimes be a little condescending.
"How strong is Beijun?"
Chu Xiangling was even more curious about this.
"Very strong."
Feng Tianyang replied:
"Beijun is a true Shinto saint. His cultivation is unfathomable. Especially in the northern city, he is equal to invincible."
"Actually, if his strength had not relied on the environment, the original dispute with Nanjun would have ended long ago. If Nanjun goes to Winter City, he will definitely not be Beijun's opponent."
"In addition, Beijun's Frost Army is also extremely powerful. Each of them is cultivated using special methods. They are not afraid of life and death and are absolutely loyal. No city can resist them wherever they go."
"..."
As they learned more and more about Beijun, everyone in the mission couldn't help but become nervous.
How to see.
The next trip to Winter City seems not to be too comfortable.
That night, everyone was not too busy to continue their journey. Instead, they rested in Fengxiao City for one night and then packed up and set off early the next morning.
Feng Tianyang sent a team of forbidden troops to escort him.
Before leaving, Feng Tianyang approached Gu Xiu privately: "Your Majesty, Feng Tianyang is a powerful person with a domineering temper. If you are not sure, it is best not to conflict with him."
"Thank you Lord Feng City for informing me."
Gu Xiu nodded to express his gratitude, and then led the team, which had grown to more than 500 people, to set off.
The rest of the journey was smooth sailing.
Occasionally, there will be some interference from evil demons, but there are no high-level evil demons sitting around. Ordinary evil demons are vulnerable to this elite force, and it does not cause the slightest disturbance.
